title: Mandi prices and delivery costs
description: Check dated crop price records across India and estimate delivery costs in your language.
headline: Your crop. Your language.
intro: Choose your state and crop. Check when a price was recorded, then calculate the cost of bringing produce to your destination.
remember: Use this language on my next visit
error: Records could not be loaded. Please try again.
priceNote: Recorded market prices are indicative, not a sale offer. Date, market, variety and grade can change the price.
sourceNames: Market, district and unlisted crop names are shown as provided by the source.
vehicleNote: Enter the legal usable payload and the actual quoted rate. Vehicle categories are examples, not a model-specific payload approval.
invalid: Enter positive distance, load and capacity, with a non-negative rate and other costs.
estimateNote: Estimate only. Confirm minimum freight, return charges, tolls, loading and unloading with the transporter. Divide by saleable crop weight separately if packaging is included.
guideNote: Articles open in the language shown. More translations will be added after review.
methodTitle: Read the date before comparing prices
methodBody: An older record is not today's price. Monthly averages and daily observations are different. Confirm the rate and crop quality at the destination market before sending produce.
translationNote: Interface translations need local-language review. Original source names and published article languages are retained.
